Reject claimed FAIL/PASS without current native event and automatic STOP/CLOSED/exits
Reject MR-SIMULATION/1 or host-shaped data without raw OS provenance
Reject uncontrolled normalization, changed guard/operator/constant/call graph or missing pair review
Reject mismatched A identity, different current boot or wrong B target
Reject normal exit, wrong status/code/InvocationID/PID or missing matching journal event
Reject missing waitpid/role/current cgroup emptiness facts or caller_exit_pending unclosed
Keep FALLBACK_CLEANUP_ONLY/UNKNOWN; reject primary automatic capability class
Reject absent member/manifest, byte/hash/type/path mismatch or unresolved archive status
Disclose same-parser common-mode TCB; require rule independence plus independent raw review. Avoid universal independence claims
Reject absent original, wrong digest/path, member set mismatch or forged content-to-identity relation
Reject A counter/T0/deadline/receipt used as B current resource facts
Reject stale C00/real C09/current supervisor/state regardless of valid A certificate
Reject duplicate B activation or a use record outside exact freshly authorized target; no new free window
Reject contract requiring certificate inside its own earlier archive or receipt/use-record mutual hashes
